title: Safer quick match chat
notes: 💬 Quick match chat uses quick messages like "Good luck!" and "Good game!".
🧒 Players 12 and under can only send quick messages to people they don't know.
⌨️ Players 13 and up can turn on typed chat for a game. Typed chat is always on with friends you invite.
